tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the Intelligent Recruiter Agent, team roles, and hybrid RAG architecture.

tour.title: Configuration & Settings
tour.description: Review centralized Pydantic settings that drive embedding models, Qdrant collections, chunking, and fusion strategies.

tour.title: API Entry Point
tour.description: Explore the FastAPI app lifespan, routers for health, ingestion, and resume-to-JD matching.

tour.title: Ingestion Pipeline
tour.description: Follow how resumes and JDs are validated, section-chunked, embedded, and indexed into vector and lexical stores.

tour.title: Retrieval & Fusion
tour.description: See hybrid search across Qdrant and BM25, merged via RRF or weighted fusion with optional cross-encoder reranking.

tour.title: End-to-End Verification
tour.description: Run through system and API integration tests that exercise the full ingest → index → match flow.
